Hello, everyone!  🌸 

We’re excited to announce that we’ll be launching a [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/repulse/love-in-an-enchanted-realm-otome-visual-novel]Kickstarter campaign[/url] for our new otome isekai game, Love in an Enchanted Realm, soon!💖

You'll play as Elara, a gentle healer mysteriously transported to a fantasy world filled with beauty and danger. Accompanied by three enigmatic companions—each with unique abilities and hidden secrets—you must navigate a realm brimming with magic, peril, and passion. ✨

Love in an Enchanted Realm blends immersive 3D environments with anime-inspired 2D character art and sprites. Engage in dynamic combat, unravel deep mysteries, and explore heartfelt relationships in a world where magic is real, and your heart holds the key to survival. 🎮
